t: MDPE 25mmx22mm copper adaptor enables quick, secure connections between MDPE and plastic/copper pipe system (for use with Flomasta PB/PEX pipes, must be installed with the Flomasta pipe inserts). This adaptor is for use above ground (unless suitable ducting is used for the adapted pipes) engineered for safety, durability, and high-quality performance, meeting global standards and ensuring trusted reliability.
